title: Uncontested field report reaches the classifier
description: A single field report with text and no conflicting measurement, so the report classifier is actually called. A low level must not raise an alarm, whatever the classifier says.
assumptions: Synthetic exercise. Run with --stand-in-models, whose classifier is untrained and agrees with every report.

steps.text: Simulated resident says water is on the road near the river.

expectations.reason: A classifier agreeing with a low reading must not raise an alarm.
